notes.en: As a support for [[character:himeko-nova]], [[character:hm7]]'s personal damage can be ignored.

summary.en:
- March 7th: Hunt pairs especially well with Himeko • Nova as her "Shifu," as using an Assist Skill when at 6 or more Charges grants her both an Extra Turn and a 100% Action Advance. This allows for powerful rotations when flexible Action Advancers like Robin • Summeretto and Trailblazer: Remembrance are added to the mix, minimizing Action Value loss in AoE environments where Decimation Mode Himeko • Nova thrives.
- When March 7th: Hunt uses her Skill, she designates the target as her "Shifu".If she uses her Skill on a Erudition, Destruction, Hunt, or Remembrance unit, her Enhanced Basic ATK will deal Additional DMG. If March 7th: Hunt uses her Skill on a Harmony, Nihility, Preservation, or Abundance unit, her Enhanced Basic ATK will deal additional Toughness Reduction.
- After March 7th: Hunt uses a Basic ATK or after her "Shifu" launches an attack or uses their Ultimate, she gains one Charge. At seven Charges, March 7th: Hunt immediately takes action and uses her Enhanced Basic ATK.

details.en: - E2 allows [[character:hm7]] to launch a Follow-Up ATK after her "Shifu" launches a [[ability:basic]] or [[ability:skill]], as well as gaining 1 Charge and triggering the corresponding effect based on "Shifu"'s Path.
